subject: Your first tennis call starts here, {first_name}
body_paragraphs: Welcome to Predictify. Quick orientation: every ATP and WTA match in the app comes with a calibrated AI confidence score — built from Elo, surface, recent form, and head-to-head — that tells you exactly how reliable the call is. Numbers, not hot takes.
Try it now: {top_match_line}. Tap the match, see the full breakdown — winner, total games, games handicap — and lock in your call.
Pro tip: make one pick a day for 5 days and you build a streak. Streak users are 3x more likely to spot the value calls before first serve.
